description: The corner residence's head is pale veined marble, wall to wall and up to the ceiling. The shower is a sheet of glass and a slab of black stone, its head flush in the ceiling. A walnut vanity with a stone bowl on top floats under a mirror lit from behind. The privacy bolt seats with a soft click.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot
